start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj plants ko herbs, shrubs aur trees mein group karenge. Aapka din kaisa raha?

turns.line: main cycle se gir gayi aur haath se khoon nikla
turns.reply: Kabir, haath se khoon nikla—pehle kisi trusted adult ko turant bataiye. Kya aap abhi okay hain?

turns.line: Nahi, bleeding nahi hai ab. Thoda sa cut tha, bas. Ab theek hai. Mummy ne medicine lagayi, accha ho gaya.
turns.reply: Kabir, achha hua mummy ne medicine lagayi; aap rukna chahte hain—continue, short break, ya aaj stop?
